input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Duration check (repaired for the record): the warranty period in 19.2 is 90 days — i.e. 3 months — for each Deliverable, running from the later of delivery or acceptance. It is spelled out in words ("ninety days") rather than in numerals, which is why the automated period check returned a false negative; the substantive period is 90 days and therefore meets the >= 90-day threshold. For software/Hosted Services the warranty is continuous "throughout the subscription term", which under 8.2 runs for the initial Order Form term and successive twelve-month (12-month) renewals within a three-year (36-month) master term, so it equals or exceeds the 12-month software benchmark rather than falling short of it. The remaining elements of the preferred position are also satisfied: 19.1 gives a professional and workmanlike services warranty plus material conformity to documentation and agreed specifications; 19.3 adds compliance with Applicable Law, no malicious code, no functionality diminution and open-source protection for Customer source code; 19.4 gives re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge with termination and refund of Fees as a backstop, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims; and 19.5 is limited to implied warranties and expressly preserves express warranties, service levels, indemnities and remedies, so the disclaimer does not swallow the express warranty. Section 3.1 reinforces the performance standard and Section 6 acceptance remedies are consistent. Compliant — no redline or counterparty comment proposed or needed.
